name: Scrap-Yard Ballistics Contract
description: A handshake deal with local scavengers. Provides a steady stream of highly questionable, unregistered firearms.

name: Scrap-Yard Armor & Melee
description: Access to discarded industrial plating and rusted blunt instruments. Perfect for budget-conscious brawlers.

name: Basic Rations & Water
description: Standardized bulk food paste and water filtration. High volume, low margin essentials.

name: Civilian Threads (Lyra Synthetics)
description: Mass-market civilian clothing. Zero armor value, but high impulse-buy potential for station locals.

name: Salvage & Repair Tools (Nautilus)
description: Entry-level industrial tools for tearing ships apart or strapping them back together.

name: Standard Munitions Supplier
description: A bulk contract for reliable, standard-caliber kinetic ammunition.

name: Scrap-Yard Weapon Mods
description: Duct-taped flashlights and welded iron sights. Cheap upgrades for cheap guns.

name: Aulin NT Distributorship
description: Official vendor license for Aulin's mass-produced, highly reliable kinetic weaponry and fitted attachments.

name: Omni-Corp Security Contract
description: Access to standard-issue corporate security gear, including riot-control weapons and basic flak.

name: Vanguard Tactical License
description: Heavy-duty ballistic repeaters, rotary guns, and aggressive close-quarters weapon attachments.

name: Stellaris Civilian Defense
description: Sleek, civilian-market energy weapons, thermal batteries, and high-end aesthetic space suits.

name: Industrial Labor Gear
description: A combined contract for Aegis and Arx heavy-duty worker clothes, canvas gloves, and mag-boots.

name: Hazard & Medical Supply
description: Veles-brand bio-sealed hazard suits, basic Med-Tek trauma kits, and rebreather masks.

name: Quasar Diagnostics
description: High-end electronic diagnostic tools, decrypters, and precision repair equipment.

name: Breach-Tech Heavy Tools
description: Industrial-grade plasma cutters, hydraulic spreaders, and heavy pneumatic rivet guns.

name: Scatter & Breach Munitions
description: A specialized contract for shotgun shells, bandoliers, and kinetic breaching slugs.

name: Kodiak Arsenal
description: Military-spec pulse rifles, plasma shrouds, and massively reinforced heavy armor suits.

name: Zastava Magnetic Tech
description: Devastating magnetic accelerator rifles, gauss spikes, and x-ray sniper optics.

name: Kessler Expeditionary
description: Top-of-the-line planetary exploration suits, deployable bivouacs, and survival geo-locators.

name: Aegis Active Security
description: Advanced personal defense armor including repulsor vests and energy-shielded combat helmets.

name: Arx Heavy Armatura
description: Unforgiving, steel-plated industrial pressure suits and reinforced greaves.

name: Advanced Melee Weaponry
description: High-tier close combat tools including mono-katanas, plasma-axes, and stun batons.

name: High-Energy Munitions
description: Wholesale supplier of heavy plasma canisters, tactical coolant rigs, and thermal batteries.

name: Artillery & Explosives
description: Highly regulated access to mortars, unguided RPGs, and heavy counter-weight weapon stocks.

name: Tessier-Ashpool Verified Vendor
description: Exclusive access to ridiculously expensive, cutting-edge smart-flechette weapons and neural-link optics.

name: Antique Collector's Network
description: A private network sourcing perfectly preserved Pre-War ballistic weapons and wooden sporting goods.

name: Blackwood Ordnance
description: Military artillery attachments including massive autocannon belts, fluted barrels, and artillery sights.

name: Exotic Ordinance
description: Highly illegal or fiercely regulated weaponry, including singularity launchers and archaic liquid fuel.

name: Kinetic-Tek Smart Systems
description: Premium weapon enhancements including biometric grips, speed-loaders, and eye-tracking smart optics.

name: Unrestricted Bio-Medical
description: Under-the-counter access to severe trauma solutions like anti-radiation flush and synthetic skin.
